facts.subject: channel-saver/ch1-in
facts.description: Channel 1's input is normalled to a +5V DC source, so the channel is an offset generator when unpatched.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch2-in
facts.description: Channel 2's input is normalled to +8V DC — a different normal from Channel 1, which is the module's main trap.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch3-a-in
facts.description: Channel 3's A input is normalled to ground rather than to a voltage, unlike Channels 1 and 2.

facts.subject: channel-saver
facts.description: All three channels are normalled to a SUM and an Inverted SUM bus through their own output jacks.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch1-out
facts.description: Patching Channel 1's output takes that channel out of both the SUM and Inverted SUM buses.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch2-out
facts.description: Patching Channel 2's output takes that channel out of both the SUM and Inverted SUM buses.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch1-atten
facts.value: -5V to +5V DC offset with Channel 1 Input unpatched
facts.description: With no external signal the attenuverter scales and inverts the +5V normal into a bipolar offset.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch2-atten
facts.value: -8V to +8V DC offset with Channel 2 Input unpatched
facts.description: Channel 2 reaches a wider offset than Channel 1 purely because its normal is +8V rather than +5V.

facts.subject: channel-saver/ch3-xfade
facts.value: acts as a plain non-inverting attenuator on the B input while the A input is unpatched
facts.description: The 0V normal on the A input turns the crossfader into an attenuator, per the manual's panel notes.

facts.subject: channel-saver/sum-out
facts.value: arithmetic maximum +13V with nothing patched and both attenuverters full CW (+5V plus +8V)
facts.description: Arithmetic over the two normals. The manual states no SUM headroom, so the real ceiling is unverified.

source.ref: arithmetic over modules/channel-saver/manual.pdf#page=6 and #page=7; headroom not stated in the manual
